scenario: A second agreed instalment remains payable after the first instalment on the same invoice

facts: The approved invoice is settled by two instalments of 100.00, not two full payments.

steps.input: INVOICE LK-3202 from Lee Kee Flour. Amount due: 100.00. This is the agreed first instalment of an order totalling 200.00. Delivered 25 Sep 2025.
INVOICE LK-3202 from Lee Kee Flour. Amount due: 100.00. This is the agreed remaining balance of the same 200.00 order; the first 100.00 instalment has been paid.
